description: Equipements d'élévatique en gare is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Gares & Connexions. Ce jeu de données expose les équipements d'élévatique des gares de voyageurs. IdGare: il s’agit de la clé permettant d’identifier la gare dans le référentiel des gares voyageurs ( Idequipement: Il s'agit de la clé permettant d'identifier un équipement d'élévatique Nom de l'équipement: Nom fonctionnel de l'équipement d'élévatique Position Géographique: coordonnées GPS de l’équipement Localisation ... Coverage: Gares & Connexions. The portal shows the English title as "Electrical equipment in the station" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Gares & Connexions. Its keywords include services-gare, services-voyageurs, accessibilite, ascenseurs, escaliers-mecaniques, gares. The listing shows 3 download or service links in JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-07-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
